# OMP Oracle

> Extension for Oh My Pi (OMP) and pi that sends hard, long-running work to ChatGPT or Grok through
> the web app. `/oracle` packs a context-rich archive of the repository, hands it with the prompt to
> the selected provider in an isolated browser session, and returns immediately. The answer is saved
> to disk, and the session that asked gets one best-effort wake-up when it lands. Uses the operator's
> own ChatGPT or Grok subscription, not an API key. Experimental public beta. Community project; not
> affiliated with or endorsed by the Oh My Pi maintainers, the pi-oracle maintainer, OpenAI, or xAI.

## Install

- Oh My Pi: `omp install omp-oracle`. pi: `pi install npm:omp-oracle`.
- `omp-oracle` is this fork's npm package. `pi-oracle` on npm is the upstream package, does not carry
  the fork's changes, and must not stay installed alongside it.

## Boundaries

- Per job, exactly two things leave the machine, under the operator's own account: the prompt and one
  project archive (`.tar.zst` for ChatGPT up to 250 MiB, `.tar.gz` for Grok up to 200 MiB).
- Archive inputs must resolve inside the project without symlink escapes; `.git`, tool state,
  `secrets/`, `.env*`, keys, and databases are excluded by default.
- The operator's real browser profile is read for cookies once, read-only, and never automated by
  default; driving a signed-in Chrome through the relay is opt-in.
- No telemetry and no hosted control plane. A single-operator local tool, not a hosted, multi-user, or
  API-key route.
